title: 第11章 终于可以加点了第12章 大师侄你不对劲
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
“多亏了你送我的这把刀，用一般的刀根本不可能这么简单斩下它的头颅。”
慕璃手腕一震，甩掉横刀上的些许黑色液体，对这把刀的第一次实战表现很满意。
既然知道慕璃能对付僵尸，顾铮怎么能放过这样一个强力的助手，之前就派李婶去请她了。
只是没想到的是地点没说清楚，差点没能坚持到慕璃赶到。
她要是再晚一点，顾铮就坚持不下去了，得跑路回现代了。
至于为什么不继续跟‘曲婷婷’虚与委蛇，那是因为顾铮心中恶心实在压抑不住了，跟一个非人的玩意打情骂俏这么久已经是他的极限。
现在看来，温伦和这恶心玩意早就有过负距离的接触，这是不亚于‘亡灵骑士’‘草莽英雄’‘操虫技师’炸裂现象。
“这鬼物是什么？你怎么招惹上了这鬼物？”慕璃捂着嘴一脸嫌弃的看着还在喷射黑色液体的无头尸体。
“啊？”
顾铮神色差异：“我还想问你呢。至于怎么招惹上她的，估计是我多嘴了吧。”
他把来龙去脉讲述了一遍，心中猜测是他对温伦说的那番话被‘曲婷婷’知道了，慕璃这才明白，柳眉微皱：“按照这个情况，温伦只怕是凶多吉少了。”
“明天去他家看看情况，算是仁至义尽了。”
…………
回到家，陈叔奇怪曲婷婷没跟着回来，问了一句，顾铮只是笑而不语，他便识趣的没有再问。
毕竟他只是一个签了卖身契的仆人。
【顾铮——】
【功法：食气录（未入门）+，蛰龙吐纳法（未入门）+，大泼风刀（未入门）+】
【精粹：6】
就在慕璃杀死‘曲婷婷’的瞬间，他就感受到了铜镜有所反应，精粹从0变成了6，他这才明白精粹的获得方式。
“皇天不负苦心人啊，我终于知道精粹的获取方式了。”

顾铮喜不自胜，有了初步的判断，只是孤证不举，还需要其他的验证，万一只有杀死‘曲婷婷’一样的鬼物才能获得精粹呢？
虽然可能性很小，但不代表没有。
但随即，顾铮又开始头痛了，如果真的只有杀死妖魔鬼怪才能获得精粹，那他以后就要与妖魔鬼怪为伍了。
人家对妖魔鬼怪避之不及，他却要去主动追寻妖魔鬼怪。
除非他放弃金手指，不想增强实力。
“算了，想这么多也是无济于事，先试试加点功能。”
此时，三门功法后面的加号从灰色变成了黑色，表示可以加点了。
顾铮目光落在‘食气录’后面的加号上，集中精神，一种莫名的感觉袭上心头，念头一动就见加号晃动了一下。
‘未入门’三个字顿时变得模糊起来，过了几秒钟，便被‘第一层’所取代。
胸口的中丹田中出现了一缕气，并且迅速壮大。
更加匪夷所思的是一道道玄奥的信息凭空出现在脑海中，有关食气录的领悟变得通透了许多，入门三步，出现气感，感受到一缕气，日日不辍壮大这这一缕气，终于进入了食气录第一层的经历也出现在他脑海中……
content_en:
"Thanks to the knife you gave me, it's impossible to cut off its head so easily with an ordinary knife."
Mu Li's wrist shook and she shook off some black liquid on the horizontal knife. She was very satisfied with the knife's first actual combat performance.
Now that he knew Mu Li could deal with zombies, how could Gu Zheng let go of such a powerful assistant? He had sent Aunt Li to invite her before.
What I didn't expect was that the location was not specified clearly, and I almost couldn't hold on until Mu Li arrived.
If she were a little later, Gu Zheng wouldn't be able to hold on anymore and would have to run away and go back to modern times.
As for why he didn't continue to flirt with 'Qu Tingting', it was because Gu Zheng couldn't suppress the nausea in his heart. Flirting with an inhuman thing for so long was his limit.
Now it seems that Wen Lun has had negative distance contact with this disgusting thing for a long time. This is no less than the explosion phenomenon of the 'Undead Knight', 'Rough Hero' and 'Insect Technician'.
"What is this ghost? How did you provoke this ghost?" Mu Li covered her mouth and looked at the headless corpse that was still spraying black liquid with disgust.
"Huh?"
Gu Zheng's expression was different: "I still want to ask you. As for how I provoked her, I guess I was too talkative."
He told the whole story, guessing that what he said to Wen Lun was known to 'Qu Tingting'. Only then did Mu Li understand, and her eyebrows furrowed slightly: "According to this situation, Wen Lun is probably in danger."
"I'll go to his house tomorrow to check on the situation. It's an act of kindness and justice."
…………
When he got home, Uncle Chen was surprised that Qu Tingting didn't come back with him and asked. Gu Zheng just smiled and said nothing, so he was sensible and didn't ask again.
After all, he was just a servant who signed a contract to sell himself.
【Gu Zheng——】
[Exercise techniques: Food Qi Record (not yet started)+, Hidden Dragon Breathing Technique (not yet started)+, Big Splashing Wind Knife (not yet started)+]
【Quality: 6】
The moment Mu Li killed 'Qu Tingting', he felt the bronze mirror react, and the essence changed from 0 to 6. Only then did he understand how to obtain the essence.
"The emperor has paid off his hard work. I finally know how to obtain the essence."
Gu Zheng was overjoyed. He had made a preliminary judgment, but there was no evidence. He still needed other verifications. What if he could only obtain the essence by killing a ghost like 'Qu Tingting'?
Although the possibility is small, it does not mean that it is impossible.
But then, Gu Zheng started to have a headache again. If the essence could only be obtained by killing monsters and monsters, then he would have to associate with monsters and monsters in the future.
People avoid monsters and ghosts, but he actively pursues them.
Unless he gives up his golden finger and doesn't want to increase his strength.
"Forget it, it's useless to think about it so much. Let's try adding some functions first."
At this time, the plus sign behind the three skills changed from gray to black, indicating that you can add points.
Gu Zheng's eyes fell on the plus sign behind the 'Shiqi Record', and he concentrated on it. An inexplicable feeling came over his heart. As soon as he thought about it, he saw the plus sign shaking.
The words 'not yet started' suddenly became blurred, and after a few seconds, they were replaced by 'first level'.
A wisp of Qi appeared in the Zhongdantian on the chest, and it grew rapidly.
What was even more incredible was that mysterious information appeared in his mind out of thin air. His understanding of the Qi Shi Lu became much clearer. Three steps into the process, he felt the sense of Qi and felt a wisp of Qi. He continued to strengthen this wisp of Qi day by day, and finally entered the first level of the Qi Shi Lu. The experience also appeared in his mind...
